CONFIDENTIAL

REPORT
Date April 16, 1937.
Subject Robert DURRER, German - Sino-German "Barter" Trade Agreement.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by
In continuation of a previous report dated March 31,
1937 on the above subject, it has now been learned that Mr.
DURRER intends returning to China in either June or July
of this year in order to conduct further negotiations with
Nanking regarding the Sino-German "barter" trade agreement.
It has been ascertained that DURRER, who is a Pro-
fessor at the University of Berlin and who AT PRESENT
occupies the chair in Metallurgy at that institution, is
only able to make flying visits to China during vacation
periods with the express permission of the University
authorities; he intends to remain in China on his next visit
for about three months, i.e. the entire period of the
summer vacation.
He will again be acting on behalf of "HAPRO," the
full name of which is "HAndelsgesellschaft fuer Industrielle
PROdukte." (Industrial Products Trading Company.).
D.S. Pitts
cl.
D. S.
D.C. (Special Branch).

报告
日期：1937年4月16日。
主题：罗伯特·杜雷尔（Robert DURRER），德国人——中德“易货”贸易协定。
制作人：D.S. Pitts。转发人
继1937年3月31日关于上述主题的上一份报告之后，现获悉杜雷尔先生打算于今年六月或七月返回中国，以便就中德“易货”贸易协定与南京方面进行进一步谈判。
经查证，杜雷尔系柏林大学教授，目前在该校担任冶金学教席，他仅在获得大学当局明确许可的情况下，方能利用假期对中国进行短暂访问；他打算在下次访问期间在中国停留约三个月，即整个暑假期间。
他将再次代表“HAPRO”行事，该机构全称为“HAndelsgesellschaft fuer Industrielle PROdukte”（工业产品贸易公司）。
D.S. Pitts
cl.
D. S.
副督察（特别处）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL REPORT
File No. 7853
Special Branch - CS6. Station, 3
Date March 31, 19 37.

Subject Communication dated March 16, 1937 from H.B.M. Consulate-General
regarding one Robert DURRER, a German.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by Em Golden DS/.

Robert DURRER, German, a Professor in Metallurgy at the
University of Berlin, last arrived in Shanghai on March 8,
1937 from Singapore on the s.s. "Conte Verde." He re-
turned to Singapore en route for Berlin on March 26, 1937
on the s.s. "Scharnhorst."

Durrer remained at the Park Hotel in Shanghai for a day
after his arrival here and then made his way to Nanking. It
has been ascertained that the object of his trip to Nanking
was connected with certain financial details relating to the
x Sino-German "barter" trade agreement signed in the spring of
1936 between representatives of high Nanking officials and
delegates of the Reich Government.

The terms of this agreement, in brief, were designed to
provide Germany with Chinese raw materials, especially fats,
in exchange for German heavy armaments, electrical and tex-
tile machinery.

Part of Mr. Durrer's duties consisted of arranging de-
tails as to the nature, price and amount of goods to be ex-
changed and the means of transportation to be employed. In
this connection, it has been learned that the gentleman in
question is acting on behalf of the well-known Berlin trading
firm "Hapro," which, being a semi-governmental organisation,
is virtually responsible for the carrying out of the "trade
details" of the "barter."

"Hapro" conducts business in every commodity from the
export of heavy machinery to the import of pea-nuts and has
been entrusted by the Reich Government with the task of con-
ducting all negotiations necessary with the Chinese Government
for the successful consummation of the agreement.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
机密报告
档案号：7853
特别处 - CS6。分站，3
日期：1937年3月31日。

主题：英国驻上海总领事馆1937年3月16日来函，涉及一名叫罗伯特·杜雷尔（Robert DURRER）的德国人。

制作人：D.S. Pitts。转发人 Em Golden DS/。

罗伯特·杜雷尔，德国人，柏林大学冶金学教授，最近于1937年3月8日乘“康特·维尔德”号（s.s. "Conte Verde"）轮船从新加坡抵达上海。他于1937年3月26日乘“沙恩霍斯特”号（s.s. "Scharnhorst"）轮船经新加坡返回柏林。

杜雷尔抵达上海后在公园饭店（Park Hotel）住了一天，随后前往南京。经查证，他此次南京之行的目的与1936年春季由南京高官代表与德国政府代表团签署的中德“易货”贸易协定相关的某些财务细节有关。

简而言之，该协定的条款旨在为中国向德国提供原材料（特别是油脂），以交换德国的重型军火、电气和纺织机械。

杜雷尔先生的部分职责包括安排交换货物的性质、价格和数量以及所采用的运输方式的细节。在这方面，据悉这位先生是代表著名的柏林贸易公司“Hapro”行事的，该公司作为一个半政府组织，实际上负责执行“易货”的“贸易细节”。

“Hapro”经营各种商品业务，从重机械出口到花生进口，并受德国政府委托，负责与中国政府进行所有必要的谈判，以成功完成该协定。

Robert DURRER, German.

I attach S.B. 12 on the above person.

He returns to Singapore on the 2nd or 3rd of
April this year, leaving the same day for Germany
by Air.

His last visit to Singapore was on 15/7/36 when
he arrived from Berlin by plane and left two days later
for Nanking. He returned on 12/10/36 by ship and stayed
two days taking K.L.M. plane to Berlin again.

For your information.

(sgd.) J.H. Nicholson.

发自：新加坡外侨登记官。
致：新加坡特别处处长。

1937年3月2日。

罗伯特·杜雷尔，德国人。

兹附上关于上述人员的 S.B. 12 表格。

他是柏林大学的冶金学教授，正前往南京。这是他第三次东方之行，他说这是最快的一次。

他于1937年2月25日离开罗马，途经雅典、亚历山大、利迪亚（Lydia）、巴格达、巴士拉、布什尔（Bushire）、贾斯克（Djask）和卡拉奇。然后穿越印度到达新加坡，于1937年3月1日抵达。

住在阿德菲酒店（Adelphi）且同名同姓的那位瑞士人与他并无亲属关系。他对竟有另一人同名感到惊讶，称这是一个罕见的名字。他来自博登湖（Bodensee）地区，与其说是德国人，不如说更像是瑞士人。

当被问及是否在政府部门任职时，他回答“部分是”，但表示他访问南京的目的是从事与大学有关的工作。

他将于今年4月2日或3日返回新加坡，并于同日乘飞机前往德国。

他上一次访问新加坡是在1936年7月15日，当时他乘飞机从柏林抵达，两天后离开前往南京。他于1936年10月12日乘船返回，停留两天后再次乘坐荷兰皇家航空公司（K.L.M.）飞机前往柏林。

供你参考。

（签名）J.H. 尼科尔森。
